math: R_t,k=(1-h_k)R_(t-1),k+w_k*A_(t-1-lag_k); departures_t=sum_k h_k R_t,k times leave probability; destination absorption convolved with terminal residence

evidence.scope: Train held weeks modulo5==0 only; valid nonterminal residences, NOT total-trip predictor MAE
evidence.fit: Other Train weeks; moments conditioned on cell, incoming heading, destination bearing8/distance4, departure UTC4-hour period and weekend
evidence.interpretation: A ratio above1 indicates positive dependence remaining under this COARSE historical mean model. It may reflect omitted context as well as a shared trip effect. It does not prove a causal driving style or irreducible uncertainty, and it is not a travel-time MAE result.

shared_trip_effect_hypothesis.next: Consider a query-level shared latent environment ONLY after testing efficient independent-phase model. A shared environment must be marginalized over at query and learned solely with Train paths; no true query route or completed Validation trips.

references.title: Bayesian Dynamic Gamma Models for Route-Level Travel Time Reliability
references.supports: Common latent environment can induce cross-segment dependence; I55 sensor route reliability, not Porto OD MAE. Our adaptation would use phase-type residence and unknown spatial paths, not reproduce its Gamma/F model.

references.title: Link Representation Learning for Probabilistic Travel Time Estimation / ProbETA
references.supports: Hierarchical link representation with intra/inter-trip dependence. Its adjacent-completed-trip query information differs from primary static OD; only the dependence mechanism is relevant here.
